password.hint: Every device, this one included, will need to sign in again.

persons.title: Persons
persons.name: Name
persons.nicknamesHint: Separated by commas. Used by Voice Entry and never shown in the views.
persons.archiveHint: An archived Person leaves pickers and filters but stays on past Entries and Tasks.
persons.inUse: Entries or Tasks mention this Person. Archive them instead.
persons.keepBirthday: Keep {{name}}'s Birthday on the calendar, for the whole Family? Cancel removes it.

entryTypes.title: Entry Types
entryTypes.name: Name
entryTypes.defaultsHint: They pre-fill new Entries of this type. Changing them never changes existing Entries.
entryTypes.moveEntries: Choose where each {{name}} Entry goes. Those you leave move to General.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.hint: Notifications for Entries and Tasks on this device only.
reminders.notSetUp: Reminders are not set up on this server.
reminders.unsupported: This browser cannot show push notifications.
reminders.addToHome: On iPhone and iPad, add the app to the Home Screen first, then open it from there to turn on Reminders.
reminders.denied: Notifications are blocked for this app. Allow them in the browser or system settings, then try again.
reminders.failed: Could not turn on notifications. Try again.
reminders.familyWide: Items for no Person in particular (Family-wide) always remind.

entries.title: Title
entries.familyWideHint: With nobody picked, the Entry is for the whole Family.
entries.privateHint: Stays discreet on the wall, in Reminders, in the Feed and in the Briefing.
entries.badTime: The end must come after the start.
entries.confirmDelete: Delete "{{title}}" for good? This can't be undone.
entries.birthdaySynced: This Birthday follows {{name}}'s date of birth: change its date or Person on the Person.
entries.birthYearKnown: Birth year known (the date above is the date of birth, so the age shows)
entries.birthdayLocked: This Birthday's date and Person change only on its Person.

newItem.title: New
newItem.entryHint: An Entry sits on the calendar at a date or time.
newItem.taskHint: A Task is something to get done and tick off, with an optional deadline.

convert.confirmToTask: Turn "{{title}}" into a task? It keeps its title, notes, location, Persons, importance and repetition, due on its date. Its type, icon, end, reminders and changed occurrences go, and what was in its Preparation stays, unlinked.
convert.confirmToEntry: Turn "{{title}}" into an entry? It keeps its title, notes, Persons, importance and repetition, on its due date (today if it has none). Whether it was done, and the entry it prepared for, go.
convert.confirmListToEntry: Turn "{{title}}" into an entry? It goes on the calendar over its period (today if it has none), and its items stay as that entry's Preparation.

tasks.title: Title
tasks.familyWideHint: With nobody picked, the Task is for the whole Family.
tasks.confirmDelete: Delete "{{title}}" for good? This can't be undone.
tasks.repeatNeedsDate: Give it a due date to make it repeat.
tasks.repeatHint: Ticking it brings up the next one, due on the first date after today.
tasks.withItemsHint: A task can hold a list of items, and each item items of its own.
tasks.withItemsOnHint: Saving opens its page to add the items. The due day becomes its deadline; the time, importance, notes and Private aren't kept.

checklists.name: Name
checklists.periodHint: Both are optional. Before its start it isn't pending; at its end its undone items are overdue.
checklists.personsHint: Each item keeps its own Persons.
checklists.confirmDelete: Delete "{{name}}" and its items for good?
checklists.repeatHint: Rounds count from {{date}}. Each round starts with every item undone and lasts until the end, or only its first day without one.
checklists.useAgainHint: Starts a new round now: every item undone. Only this round's result is kept.
checklists.remindAtStart: Remind at 09:00 on the first day
checklists.itemNoteHint: E.g. Aldi, still to buy, pick up on Saturday
checklists.itemParentTop: At the top of the list
checklists.dragHint: Tip: drag a task onto a task with items to move or copy it there (on a phone, press and hold it first). Swipe an item sideways on its page to remove it.

addTo.title: Add to a task with items
addTo.hint: Move makes it one of its items, without its date, time, repetition or Private. Duplicate adds an item with the same title and people and keeps this task.
addTo.question: Add "{{title}}" to "{{name}}"?

checklistTemplates.title: Predefined lists
checklistTemplates.hint: Ready-made lists of items for a task. Built-in ones show in each device's language until edited.
checklistTemplates.confirmRestore: Bring back the built-in templates as they came? Your own templates stay as they are.
checklistTemplates.name: Template name
checklistTemplates.confirmDelete: Delete the template "{{name}}"? Tasks made from it stay as they are.

holidays.title: Public Holidays
holidays.hint: Shown on every device; each device can hide them from the Person filter.
holidays.municipalityHint: A municipal holiday that isn't listed can be added as a yearly Entry.

feeds.title: Calendar Feeds
feeds.hint: Other calendar apps (your phone, your work calendar) can subscribe to a read-only address.
feeds.confirmReplace: Replace the address of "{{name}}"? The old address stops working.
feeds.confirmRevoke: Revoke "{{name}}"? Its address stops working for good.
feeds.name: Feed name
feeds.noneHint: With nobody picked, the Feed covers everyone.
feeds.copyNow: Copy this address now; it won't be shown again.

offline.notice: You're offline. This is the last loaded calendar; changes need a connection.

export.title: Export
export.hint: Your data is also kept outside Cloudflare. A full Export includes Private items.

briefing.failed: The briefing could not be refreshed. Try again.

weather.title: Weather
weather.hint: The selected place is used on every device.
weather.searchFailed: The search is not available right now.

voice.title: Voice Entry
voice.failed: Could not understand that. Try again.
voice.hint: Say or type a sentence to add an Entry, a Task or things to buy. This device only.
voice.readback: Read the summary aloud and listen for the answer
voice.scopeQuestion: Only this time or from now on?
voice.oneAtATime: One thing at a time, please
voice.refused: Voice Entry doesn't delete; open the item to delete it
voice.locked: A Birthday's date and Person change on the Person
voice.micDenied: The microphone is blocked for this site and the browser no longer asks. In Chrome: tap the icon left of the address (or ⋮ › Settings › Site settings › Microphone), choose Allow for this site and try again. If it still fails, check Android Settings › Apps › Chrome › Permissions allows the microphone. You can also type the sentence.
voice.micDismissed: The microphone wasn't allowed. Press the microphone again and choose Allow, or type the sentence.
voice.notHeard: I didn't hear anything. Press the microphone and speak, or type the sentence.
voice.micFailed: Speech recognition isn't working here ({{code}}). Use the keyboard's microphone to dictate, or type the sentence.

school.endSecondary: Last day of school: years 9, 11 and 12
school.endMiddle: Last day of school: years 5 to 8 and 10
school.endPrimary: Last day of school: pre-school and years 1 to 4

waste.title: Rubbish collection
waste.hint: The days each bin is collected in your street. They show on the calendar when "Rubbish collection" is on in the filter.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.lead: Write or say what repeats in the family's life, or open a theme, and create it all at once after a review.
suggestions.placeholder: gym on Monday and Wednesday at 7pm, groceries on Tuesday and Thursday at 10am, water the plants on Saturday, car, dog
suggestions.failed: Could not understand that. Try again or pick from the themes below.
suggestions.needsAnswer: Answer above to work out the dates.
suggestions.reviewHint: Soonest first. Nothing is saved until you tap Create.
suggestions.createFailed: Could not create everything, so nothing was saved. Try again.

car.name: Car
car.intro: With the registration date, the app works out the IUC and the inspections.

home.name: Home
home.intro: Taxes, insurance and the upkeep you only remember when something breaks.

bills.name: Monthly bills
bills.intro: The ones you pay by hand become Tasks; direct debits only show as a notice on the calendar.

school.name: School
school.intro: What falls to the family each school year.

routine.name: Weekly routine
routine.intro: Change the days and times in the review, before creating.

ideas.boiler: Service the boiler or water heater
ideas.schoolFees: Pay the school or after-school club

hints.iuc: In 2026 in the registration month; in 2027 in October; from 2028 in April
hints.inspection: When the car is 4, 6 and 8, then every year
hints.imi: May, or May and November, or May, August and November

notes.inspection: It can be done in the 3 months before this date.
notes.irs: The return is filed from 1 April to 30 June.
notes.iuc: It is paid on the Portal das Finanças.
notes.imi: It is paid on the Portal das Finanças.

suggestions.forWhomHint: Each person gets a line of their own, to give them their own day and time. With nobody ticked, it is for the family.
suggestions.togetherHint: Several people on one line make one entry, for when they go together.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.none: Nothing linked yet: add a checklist or task to prepare for this.

search.title: Search
search.hint: Any of the words finds a result; "quoted text" must appear as written; -word leaves out what has it. Case and accents don't matter.
search.start: Type something or pick a filter.
search.more_one: …and {{count}} more: narrow the search to see it.
search.more_other: …and {{count}} more: narrow the search to see them.

help.title: Help on buttons
help.hint: Rest the pointer on a button, or press and hold it, to see what it does.

levels.low: Low: just the name of icon buttons
levels.medium: Medium: name and what it does
levels.high: High: also what follows, and ⓘ on field titles

day.what: Shows one day hour by hour.
day.more: Swipe or use the arrows to move a day at a time.

week.what: Shows the seven days of a week side by side.
week.more: Swipe or use the arrows to move a week at a time.

month.what: Shows the whole month, one square per day.
month.more: Tap a day to see everything on it.

year.what: Shows the twelve months of the year at a glance.
year.more: Days with something on are marked; tap one to see it.

agenda.what: Lists what's coming, day by day, as a list.
agenda.more: Handy on a phone: no grid, just what's next.

tasks.more: Grouped by when they're due; overdue ones come first.

shopping.more: One list for everyone, grouped by section; it can be narrowed to one shop.

previous.what: Goes back one period: a day, week, month or year, by the view.
previous.more: Swiping to the right does the same.

next.what: Goes forward one period: a day, week, month or year, by the view.
next.more: Swiping to the left does the same.

today.what: Comes back to today in the view you're in.

search.what: Finds Entries and tasks by their words.
search.more: Several words find any of them; "in quotes" finds the exact phrase; -word leaves it out.

filter.what: Shows only some Persons, and picks the extra layers.
filter.more: Only this device is filtered; the others see everything.

newEntry.what: Adds something new on the date you are viewing: an Entry or a Task.
newEntry.more: The app picks from the title; you can change it at the top of the form.

newTask.more: Switch on "With items" to give it a list of items to tick.

voice.what: Creates an Entry by speaking or typing a sentence.
voice.more: You see what was understood and choose to save or edit it.

suggestions.what: Ideas for the calendar, from what you write or dictate.
suggestions.more: You choose which to create, and can undo.

settings.what: Opens Settings: Family, calendar, this device and account.

close.what: Closes and returns to where you were.

weather.name: Weather
weather.what: Opens the weather in detail: the hours and the next days.

edit.what: Opens the form to change it.

back.what: Closes this and returns to where you were.

save.more: Every device in the Family sees them straight away.

cancel.more: What you changed here is lost.

entryType.what: The kind of Entry, such as an appointment or a birthday.
entryType.more: It sets the Entry's colour and icon; types are managed in Settings › Family.

importance.more: Important Entries stand out in the views and come first in the briefing.

taskImportance.more: Important tasks are listed first and show a mark.

persons.more: With none picked it's for the whole Family. The Person Filter uses this.

wall.name: Wall
wall.what: Turns this device into the wall calendar: the week and today's Entries, read-only.
wall.more: Press it again to turn it off and return to where you were.

summary.name: Summary
summary.what: Shows today at a glance: the weather by the hour, sunrise and sunset, and what's coming up.
summary.more: Press it again to return to where you were.

weatherToggle.what: Shows or hides the weather: on the weekday row of the day and the week, and beside each day of the month.
weatherToggle.more: In the day view it also shows the next hours.

sleep.title: Sleeping hours
sleep.hint: The hours the Family is usually asleep. In the day and week views they show shorter and shaded, and grow back when something is on.

shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.name: Name
shopping.empty: The list is empty: add what's missing at home.
shopping.hint: Tap an item once it's in the basket; swipe it sideways to remove it. Bought items leave the list tomorrow.

reset.title: Danger zone
reset.hint: Deletes what you tick for good. The password, the recovery email and the signed-in devices stay.

details.entries: Every entry, Private ones included. People's birthdays stay as long as the people do.
details.tasks: Every task, with its items and rounds.
details.shopping: The list's items and the history behind its suggestions.
details.persons: The people, their nicknames and birthdays. Their entries and tasks stay, for the whole family.
details.entryTypes: Types you made go (their entries become General) and the built-in ones are reset.
details.templates: Lists you made go and the built-in ones are reset.
details.settings: Holidays, bins, weather, sleeping hours and calendar feeds.

reset.all: Tick everything: start again as a new family
reset.before: Before deleting, this device downloads the full Export and the server keeps a copy that can be restored by hand.
reset.confirm: Delete what you ticked? This can't be undone in the app.
reset.confirmAll: Delete everything and start again as a new family? This can't be undone in the app.
reset.done: Deleted. The Export was saved on this device.
